lines.say: Your app's server died at three A-M.
By morning, your app was running on another server. Nobody touched it.
lines.show: By morning, your app was running *on another server.* Nobody touched it.

lines.say: That's Kubernetes. It runs copies of your app across a group of servers.
lines.show: That's *Kubernetes.* It runs copies of your app across [a group of servers.]

lines.say: You tell it what you want, and it keeps making it true.
lines.show: You tell it what you want, and it *keeps making it true.*

lines.say: Like a thermostat. You set twenty-one degrees, and it keeps the room there.
lines.show: Like a *thermostat.* You set *21°,* and it keeps the room there.

lines.say: A server dies? It starts replacement copies on the servers that are left.
lines.show: A server [dies?] It starts replacements *on the servers that are left.*

lines.say: Turn on autoscaling, and it adds copies when more users show up, then removes them when they leave.
lines.show: Turn on *autoscaling,* and it [adds copies] when more users show up, then removes them when they leave.

lines.say: New version? It swaps old copies for new ones a few at a time, so your app stays up during the update.
lines.show: New version? It swaps copies *a few at a time,* so your app [stays up] during the update.

lines.say: That's how your app recovered while you slept.
lines.show: That's how your app *recovered while you slept.*

lines.say: If you're a vibe coder, follow for the system design your AI skipped.
lines.show: If you're a vibe coder, follow for the system design your AI [skipped.]
